title: Lifting sections from the reduced support of an adjoint
main_claim: Setup: (V,C) is a projective Q-factorial dlt pair, G is a nonzero effective Cartier divisor with G ~ q(K_V+C) and Supp G contained in floor(C), and O(G) restricted to G_red is semiample. Claim: then kappa(K_V+C)>0. Consequence: log abundance after nonvanishing in dimension <=4, i.e. a nef lc adjoint with kappa>=0 is semiample, and it is Q-trivial when kappa=0. Combined with the companion nonvanishing paper, this gives full rational log abundance for 4-folds. There is also a conditional reduction in all dimensions to smooth canonical nonvanishing (via Hashizume).

issues.description: Two filtered statements are only sketched, not proved in detail: the comparison F_jN' = eta^*F_jN (x) omega_{B'/B} for the ramified finite flat power cover eta, and the index/Tate-twist bookkeeping for the G_m-quotient. They follow from the explicit graph-fraction description plus flat base change and Saito's non-characteristic pullback, and I believe both are correct.
issues.evidence: The proof uses the explicit pole-order description of F_jM, Kleiman-type transversality to the strata involving R, and a citation of Saito 1988 Sec. 3.5. Non-characteristic is checked for M on Y x B, not directly for N; the passage to N is by filtered flat base change and strictness.

issues.location: sections/abundance.tex, proof of Theorem abundance-after-nonvanishing; introduction Cor. full-abundance
issues.description: The application relies on external results: Birkar 2010 Cor. 1.6 (log minimal models for effective lc 4-folds) and Fujino-Gongyo 2014 Thm 4.2/4.3. The unconditional fourfold corollary also rests on the companion OpenAI nonvanishing paper, which this paper does not audit. The supported theorem itself does not depend on the companion.
issues.evidence: Explicit citations in the proof of Theorem 1.2 and Corollary 1.4.

coverage:
Read in full: introduction, covers, hodge, frames, lifting and abundance; skimmed fields. I did not audit the independent appendix (curve-base / nu=2 method), which the main result does not need.

Covers: checked ord_F(y)=1, the crepant formula, discrepancy scaling, sigma pole orders, the chi-eigensheaf = sigma*O_Z(-E) case analysis, relative KV vanishing with klt boundary D_h - eps*rho^*H_Z, and the split residue injection.

Hodge: checked the lowest pieces F_0M and F_0N, the two-term gr_1 DR complex, and the Kodaira-Saito symbol-kernel lemma.

Frames: checked that a weight-m section corresponds to Hom(J'^m, -), so the source is ample for m>0, the adjugate transport of symbols, and the Euler identity s*eps=-m*s, including why the Y-direction vertical action is null-homotopic on direct image.

Lifting: checked the Leibniz derivation and the nilpotent graph-fraction Cech expansion (mod r_0*y^k, y^{k+1}=0). Re-derived the weight bookkeeping: y has weight -1, sigma weight r/q, delta degree k, so v has weight a+k. Checked that the F=1 identity forces s_0=0, then the descent via mu_r-invariants and Laurent degree zero, and the chi-growth/bounded-h^i count.

Abundance: checked the kappa=0 case (raised boundary, M_*!=0 via the negativity lemma), the Iitaka-fibre sandwich P==0, nu=kappa, and the log-abundant step via FG14.

Sanity test: on Atiyah's P(F_2) with its non-moving section with trivial normal bundle, the analogous form has weight -r, so m=0 at k=1. The mechanism correctly fails there, as it should.
sibling_notes: This paper is the 'OpenAILifting' companion (abundance after nonvanishing) cited by Uniform-effective-log-Iitaka-fibrations (rank 187) and others in family 034. The supported lifting theorem is self-contained and does not use the nonvanishing companion. Siblings that depend on 'abundance after nonvanishing' can treat this dependency as audited with no gap found. They still depend on the separate nonvanishing companion.
